beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Cones of Meaning examines the frames that make some answers seem natural.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks readers to inspect what an explanation includes, excludes, and treats as important.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It connects how people reason with how AI systems select what matters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A cone is not presented as a literal mechanism inside a mind or model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers gain a way to challenge a frame without abandoning rigorous reasoning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An explanation begins by making some differences relevant and leaving others outside its frame.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A change of purpose can therefore change what a rigorous answer needs to include.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks who selects that frame and who carries the consequences of its omissions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Moving between frames does not mean that every explanation becomes equally good.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It means making the conditions of reasoning available for examination.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A cone can help picture selective orientation without explaining a mechanism by itself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book distinguishes mathematical resemblance, useful analogy, and evidence for a causal claim.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its own vocabulary must face that discipline rather than gain protection from it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Descriptions of AI orientation do not establish that models possess phenomenal consciousness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These boundaries keep a suggestive framework open to correction instead of turning it into doctrine.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the relation between ordinary reasoning and reflection on its chosen premises.
